finding: The ledger30 chain (645 directories, PCXF_ROOT) and the L187 replay closure (final/objs, objs, base_ref) are two module universes. They hold different objects under the same module name, so one root module cannot import both without a silent version mix: Lean does not check an imported object against the version its importers were compiled with.

base_modules_clash: PRVEq_AdapterStage1_o1, PRVEq_AdapterStage2_o1, PRVEq_CallerPrepTx1_o1 cannot be imported together (tacticDelta_matchers and PRVEq_* helper theorems are declared in each; PCVO_STATUS name_clash), so the three NOC deployed modules need three audit modules.
consequence: PRVCmb_ROOT (ledger30 chain, bundles C01..C22, one root) covers every credited file whose proof compiles in the ledger30 universe. The deployed-top-body files (P3n, P3q, P3r in the L187 closure universe; P3p in the L187-objs-over-ledger30 universe) are audited by four by-reference audit modules (PCXF_AUD_L1, L2A, L2B, L2C). That is two roots plus three, not the one combined import the brief asks for; the reason is the universe mismatch, not a failed proof.
